_comment: Well-known websites offered as web apps where a browser for remotes can open them. Written by hand; every address was checked to answer on 2026-11-21. 'kind' groups them (watch, listen, play, read, social, shop, tools, adult). 'adult' marks a site for people of 18 or over: it is hidden unless the person has switched that on. 'featured' puts it on the home page.
